video_title: Training Camp Media Availability | October 10, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his defensive development and learning curve
quotes.excerpt: I feel like I've done a good job with my motor. I'm wearing the hardest playing guys.
quotes.quote: I feel like I've done a good job with my motor. I feel like that's what coach Daigneault is challenging me to do every single day, making sure I'm wearing the hardest playing guys on the court. On top of that, there's a learning curve to it. You have to play hard but also be smart and be in the right places. I feel that's something I've done really good. Something I've got to work through is just to continue to show up every single day. Now we are professional, so you have to come and do your job every single day.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on his defensive development with the Thunder: I feel like I have done a good job with my motor. I feel like that is what coach Daigneault is challenging me to do every single day.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the importance of hitting catch-and-shoot threes
quotes.excerpt: You have to hit that catch and shoot three because the gravity is huge.
quotes.quote: It's an everyday thing. I feel like playing on a team like this, that's what you just have to be good at because you have guys like Shai, guys like Dort, Chet, you go down the list, Jalen Williams, and you have to hit that catch and shoot three because the gravity is huge. That's something I'm just working on every single day, trying to get better at. I feel like these guys are doing a good job of pumping that confidence into me to shoot it and on top of that, just working on my game.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace says hitting catch and shoot threes is a priority for him this season: Playing on a team like this, that is what you just have to be good at because you have guys like Shai, Dort, Chet, and Jalen Williams.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on the defensive impact of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander
quotes.excerpt: Playing with him out there, he makes the game so much easier defensively and offensively.
quotes.quote: I feel like he's gotten so much better since we've gotten here already. It's a testament to his work and what he does and how comfortable he is in his game. It's crazy playing with him out there, he makes the game so much easier defensively and offensively. On top of that, he's a great teammate.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on playing alongside Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: It is crazy playing with him out there, he makes the game so much easier defensively and offensively.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on following the OKC defensive blueprint
quotes.excerpt: That's the blueprint. All I got to do is just follow the blueprint.
quotes.quote: That's the blueprint. I feel like you kind of said it, OKC is known for that. All I got to do is just follow the blueprint and look at the guys ahead of me. I feel like I'm doing a good job at that and the coaches are helping me out too because like I said, there's an opportunity and there's been guys ahead of me that have done this. I just got to do my part and watch the film obviously and implement those things when I get on to the court.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace on the Thunder defensive identity: That is the blueprint. All I got to do is just follow the blueprint and look at the guys ahead of me.

quotes.speaker: Cason Wallace
quotes.summary_phrase: Cason Wallace on his defensive strengths and areas for improvement
quotes.excerpt: I think my physicality, my speed, and then my hands. I definitely want to continue to work.
quotes.quote: I think my physicality, my speed, and then my hands. I definitely want to continue to work on my hands though because Dort and Cason, they probably one of the best guys in terms of just deflections and stuff like that. Actually, Shai too. They probably one of the best guys in terms of just deflections and stuff like that. I think my hands are good already, but compared to them, it ain't nothing. So I'm trying to learn from them.
quotes.social_post: Cason Wallace says he is looking to improve his hands on defense by learning from teammates like Lu Dort and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: I think my hands are good already, but compared to them, it ain't nothing.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace's reliability and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: Off the ball is where we first noticed his reliability on that end of the floor.
quotes.quote: Off the ball is where we first noticed his reliability on that end of the floor, which made it very easy to play him as a young player. He was in the right spots, he was executing nothing fancy, but just very, very reliable in all the facets of the game that really matter. And then once he was on the court, we started to realize that he could take on pretty significant matchups. As we saw in the playoffs with Austin Reaves and Booker at times, those are big-time players and he's able to take those matchups to some degree.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Cason Wallace: Once he was on the court, we started to realize that he could take on pretty significant matchups. As we saw in the playoffs with Austin Reaves and Booker at times, he is able to take those matchups.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the importance of execution for undersized guards
quotes.excerpt: When you're undersized, that's where execution becomes premium.
quotes.quote: When you're undersized, and he's undersized, McClain's undersized, Cason can be undersized depending on who he's guarding, when you're undersized, that's okay. Not everybody needs to be 6'7", but that's where execution becomes premium. Your margin for error with execution is very low and so you've got to be an execution monster. He's off to a good start with that. He's done a good job there and that's what we've tried to do with players that maybe give something up physically.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the defensive requirements for undersized guards: When you are undersized, that is where execution becomes premium. Your margin for error with execution is very low and so you have to be an execution monster.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on resting rotation players for the Atlanta game
quotes.excerpt: We are going to not travel a number of guys just based on the rhythm of preseason.
quotes.quote: We are going to not travel a number of guys just based on the rhythm of preseason and the fact that it's a back-to-back. A large amount of our returning rotation players, if not all of our returning rotation players will not travel and will not play, just in the interest of having them physically ready to go against Indiana. We'll travel the rookie players, the two-ways, and the exhibit 10 guys. We'll have nine total guys in Atlanta.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault confirms the Thunder will rest their entire returning rotation for the upcoming preseason game in Atlanta: A large amount of our returning rotation players will not travel and will not play.
